controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:36:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:36:22.000Z"
| WHERE host.name == "web-2"
        AND message LIKE "*Accepted*"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY user.name, source.ip
